name: Wilderness bears
accessNote: Grizzly bears spawn in the low-level Wilderness west of the Graveyard of Shadows (about 10 spawns) and near the Dark Warriors' Fortress, plus north-west of the Ferox Enclave. Required for Krystilia's Wilderness bears task; bring only risk-appropriate gear as PKers frequent the area. The Slayer task/Bears location table (pageid 297754) lists the Wilderness bear spots as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat).
